nodes.title: Pack c_p 1 000 J/kg K, cell R 5 mOhm design, R(T) x 1.5 per 15 K below 25 degC
nodes.text: pack heat = I^2 x cells x R_cell(T); R_cell = 4 mOhm nominal (E2), 5 mOhm design (E2's T-E2-IR acceptance limit); R(T) = R25 x 1.5^((25 - T)/15) below 25 degC, R25 above (no credit for warm cells)

nodes.title: Flight controller top board 52 x 32 mm, 15 J/K; the R2 2.0 W lumped value is kept as the bound
nodes.text: FC node = CoreWing F405 Wing APP V2 top board + wireless board alone, on four 5 mm gel cubes, both faces exchange with the pod air; its dissipation now comes from F3 (CALC-E3-* read ASM-F3-5V-LOADS); the 5 V regulator sits on the separated power board PWR-003
nodes.basis: subsystems/avionics/params.json fc_board_m [0.052, 0.032] and fc_mass_g 12 (c ~ 1 000 J/kg K + gel and strap -> 15 J/K); F3-R2 split of the stack (CR-F3-13). Index 0 is the R2 bound (2.0 W total, F3's limit line for CL-F3-FC-DISS)

nodes.title: Other pod heat: power-board regulator + idle from F3, UBEC 0.8 W, design factor 1.25
nodes.text: heat released straight into the pod air by the CoreWing power board PWR-003 (5 V regulator losses and servo-BEC idle: CL-F3-FC-DISS minus the FC's own 5 V x (FC + wireless) load) and by the servo UBEC PWR-005 (right channel); every pod source (FC, power board, UBEC) is multiplied by the design factor until T-F3-5V runs
nodes.basis: UBEC: two elevon servos, mean 0.3-0.5 A at 6.0 V in gusty flight = 1.8-3.0 W out, eta 0.80 -> 0.45-0.75 W; 0.8 W carried. Factor 1.25 for unmeasured loads (F3 5 V budget is EST)

nodes.title: Harness resistance inside the pod 2.9 mOhm

nodes.title: Power scaling from the 2.6 kg gate to the as-designed mass
nodes.text: hover, climb, transitions and descent: P ~ m^1.5 (momentum theory, constant figure of merit); cruise: P ~ m^1.0 (about half the cruise drag is induced at 16 m/s, so dP/P = 2 x 0.5 x dm/m); currents scale with power; cruise time re-solved so the mission still ends on E2's 20 % line (same energy as the gate table)

nodes.equation: per node C dT/dt = Q(t, T) - sum G (T - T_neighbour) ; Q_motor = I_m^2 R_m(T) + I0 n/Kv, Q_esc = I_m^2 R_esc + P_fix with I_m from P_bus = I_m (n/Kv + I_m R_m) + Q_esc and Q = kP Q_B4 (n/n_B4)^2 ; ESC h = 0.664 Re^0.5 Pr^1/3 k/L at f_wake v(x), v(x) = v_i (1 + x/sqrt(x^2+R^2)) + 4 eps sigma T^3 ; pack Q = I^2 N R_cell(T) ; explicit Euler dt 0.5 s, pod air relaxed exactly

nodes.title: Motor thermal resistance and time constant on the thrust stand
nodes.procedure: One station on the H1 stand with the real printed mount, 11x5.5MR, 14.8 V. K-type thermocouples on the stator (through the base vent), between base and mount, and on the bell (IR). From ambient: hover power (~100 W bus) for 10 min, log every 5 s; fit T = T_inf - (T_inf - T_0) e^(-t/tau): R_th = (T_inf - T_amb) / loss, loss = P_in - torque x omega. Then 30 s at 24.8 A. Pass: R_th <= 1.5 K/W, base < 83 degC (ASA) at hover power from 30 degC; tube at the station collar < 58 degC (PETG).

nodes.title: ESC on a fin-pad mock-up in the slipstream
nodes.procedure: Foam-board half-fin with a 22 mm tube LE behind the stand prop; ESC strapped on the pad at x 0.101 m, 0.072 m from the axis, FET side out; thermocouple under the heat-shrink on the FETs. Hover power 10 min, then 30 s at the limiter. Tuft on the pad. Back-solve the wake factor: f = (h_meas / h_model)^2. Pass: <= 70 degC steady at hover power from 30 degC (15 K below the MCU rating).

nodes.title: Temperatures after the first full missions
nodes.procedure: Field ambient from the handheld anemometer/thermometer at take-off; IR on the four motor cans, ESCs and the pack within 60 s of landing; IMU.T and BAT current from the log. Compare with the model re-run at the measured ambient: within +-8 K, else update ASM-E3-RTH-DESIGN / ASM-E3-WAKE.
